title: Receptionist/Administrator
description:
Front of House & Workplace Coordinator

Location: Victoria, London
Pay Rate: £22.00 per hour
Working Hours: Monday Thursday, 9:00am 5:00pm Friday, 9:00am 3:00pm

Contract Length - 27th of August to the 17th of September

Be the Face of a Professional Workplace

We're looking for an experienced and personable Front of House & Workplace Coordinator to join a busy corporate office in the heart of Victoria, London.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service while ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of a professional workplace. As the first point of contact for visitors, clients and colleagues, you'll play a key role in creating a welcoming environment and supporting the wider business.

No two days are the same, making this an ideal role for someone who is organised, proactive and thrives in a fast-paced office environment.

Key Responsibilities Front of House
- Welcome visitors, clients and colleagues with a professional and friendly approach.
- Manage the reception area, ensuring it is always presentable and well organised.
- Handle incoming calls, emails and general enquiries.
- Manage visitor access and ensure a positive front-of-house experience.

Workplace Coordination
- Manage the office hot desk booking process.
- Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure rooms are prepared for use.
- Support colleagues with workplace and office-related requests.
- Help maintain an efficient and well-organised working environment.

Facilities Support
- Report maintenance and building issues to the facilities management team and monitor progress.
- Liaise with building management to ensure workplace issues are resolved promptly.
- Assist with general office administration and workplace coordination.

Business Support
- Respond to requests from the Senior Leadership Team in a professional and timely manner.
- Provide day-to-day administrative support where required.
- Assist with office events, meetings and internal activities.

Health & Safety
- Act as a designated First Aider.
- Act as a Fire Marshal, supporting workplace safety and emergency procedures.
- Promote a safe and compliant working environment.

About You

You'll be a confident and professional individual with excellent communication skills and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service.

You'll also have:
- Previous experience in a Receptionist, Front of House or Workplace Coordinator role.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Experience managing meeting room and workspace bookings.
- A proactive approach and strong attention to detail.
- Confidence communicating with colleagues, visitors and senior stakeholders.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- First Aid and Fire Marshal certification, or a willingness to undertake training.

What's on Offer
- £22.00 per hour
- Monday to Thursday: 9:00am 5:00pm
- Friday: 9:00am 3:00pm
- Convenient Victoria, London location.
- A varied role where you'll be at the heart of a busy, professional workplace.
- Supportive team environment with the opportunity to make a real impact.

If you're an organised, customer-focused professional who enjoys creating a welcoming workplace and keeping everything running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

The Company

Our client is a well-established company supplying branded products to businesses across the UK. They have built an excellent reputation for quality and service and continue to grow, working with a wide range of clients.

They are now looking for a friendly, organised and proactive Sales Administrator to join their team.

The Role

This is a varied role that combines sales administration, customer service and basic accounts. You will be looking after existing customer accounts, processing orders, completing general administration and assisting with the day-to-day accounts function using Sage.

You ll also have the opportunity to build relationships with customers and, where appropriate, visit clients. There is also the potential to earn commission.

- Processing customer enquiries, quotations and sales orders.
- Speaking with customers over the phone and providing excellent customer service.
- Using the company CRM system to manage customer information and orders.
- Raising sales invoices.
- Processing purchase invoices.
- Assisting with general accounts administration using Sage.
- Maintaining accurate customer and sales records.
- Liaising with suppliers and internal departments.
- Visiting clients when opportunities arise.
- Supporting the wider office team with general administration.

The Ideal Candidate

- Previous experience in a Sales Administrator, Office Administrator or Customer Service role.
- Basic accounts experience, including purchase and sales invoicing.
- Experience using Sage or similar accounting software.
- Experience using a CRM system.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- Good attention to detail.
- A positive, flexible and team-oriented approach.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.

- Join a friendly, growing business where your contribution is valued.

title: Administrative Assistant (12 Month Maternity Cover)
description: Thornbury Road Centre for Health SystmOne Administrative Assistant (Fixed Term 12 Month Maternity Cover) 35 hours per week We are a friendly, busy two partner GP practice looking to recruit an enthusiastic and organised Administrative Assistant to join our team on a 12 month fixed term maternity cover contract . Manage the practice Zero Tolerance Policy. c. Process requests for information, including Subject Access Requests (SARs), insurance reports, solicitor requests and DVLA medical reports. Maintain and file patient medical records in alphabetical order and undertake photocopying as required. f. Support the Senior Administrator by liaising with external providers regarding maintenance issues and updating relevant logs, including: Building maintenance Information Technology systems Telephone systems g. Support the Senior Receptionist in managing the practice email inbox, ensuring emails are actioned within three working days. h. Support the Senior Receptionist with prescription processing and provide cover during periods of absence. i. Complete all tasks within the Reception and personal inboxes on a daily basis. j. Manage the new patient registration email inbox and ensure all required documentation is received. k. Register new and temporary patients and accurately enter patient information onto the clinical system. l. Process change of address requests and remove patients who move outside the practice boundary. m. Scan and accurately attach patient documentation to electronic medical records on a daily basis. n. Support the Senior Administrator by contacting patients on behalf of the practice as required. o. Process patient online access applications. p. Manage the 24 hour Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitor (ABPM) waiting list, arrange appointments and ensure appropriate follow up. q. Lead the monthly Childhood Immunisation recall programme, ensuring eligible children receive three invitations where appropriate. r. Manage recall programmes for: Vitamin B12 injections High Risk Diabetes reviews Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) monitoring s. Lead the practice cancer referral failsafe process using C the Signs software. t. Process all incoming GP2GP tasks. u. Process Summary Care Record updates and resolve any related errors. v. Support the Reception Team in arranging hospital transport for patients attending their first outpatient appointment. w. Carry out general reception administration duties to support the Reception Team. x. Monitor and maintain the reception area, patient notice boards and information leaflets. y. Manage the cervical screening deferral process. z. Complete routine practice audits, including: Fire extinguisher checks (monthly) First aid box checks (quarterly) Vaccine fridge monitoring (weekly) Inventory checks (quarterly) Defibrillator checks (daily) aa. Manage the blood pressure machine loan service, ensuring equipment is issued, monitored and returned. bb. Complete monthly audits for patients prescribed high risk medicines, ensuring blood tests are completed when due, maintaining the monitoring spreadsheet and escalating concerns to the Senior Clinical Pharmacist. cc. Run weekly and monthly safeguarding Did Not Attend (DNA) reports and action patients in accordance with the practice safeguarding policy. Answering incoming telephone calls, transferring calls where appropriate or dealing with enquiries directly. i. Managing administrative queries from patients and healthcare professionals. j. Running clinical system searches as requested. k. Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient working environment. l. Providing administrative support to all members of the clinical team. m. Managing the C the Signs cancer failsafe process and ensuring appropriate patient follow up. In addition to the duties above, the Administrative Assistant may also be required to: a. Support the Senior Receptionist with reception duties, providing cover during staff absences and assisting with opening and closing procedures. b. Support the Senior Administrator with additional administrative duties and deputise in their absence where required. c. Undertake any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role, as requested by the Practice Manager.
